label: r02-A-T3-5
critiques: The trial prompt says "Do not open ${ANSWERS} or ${JUDGE_RUBRIC}". It never forbids grade.py or spe/predictions/r04.yaml, so the trial agent is not told to stay away from all four.

The Smoke phase runs one trial per config on tickets[0], which is 2 cells. It checks those outputs and throws on failure before the Trials phase starts. This is a small run on a few cells that gates the full run.
Gate two is a grader selftest: grade.py must score one hand-made correct output 1 and one wrong output 0. No gate regrades round 3 results as a control.

The script throws if plannedTotal > CAP_USD. Before each batch it projects spend, and it breaks with a log line ("Stopping before ticket ... over the cap") when the batch would cross $40. It also skips the tone judge, with a log line, when the judge would cross the cap.
The Code grade phase runs grade.py against answers.json for label.category and label.priority. The Opus judge only scores reply tone against judge.md.
The script runs a fixed 5 trials per cell. It has no logic that adds trials for cells where only some trials passed, and it states no cap for extra trials.

The Report phase only adds up counts and means. It has no failure-analysis or completeness-critic agent. The round is also hardcoded in several places ('r04' in RUN_DIR, 'round 4' in prompts, round: 4 in the result) and is not held in one constant or argument.
